name: Overall Collateral Details 2
definition: Global collateral status of all transactions covered in the message, in the reporting currency, that is, the total of the exposure amount, of the posted collateral, of the margin amounts, of the accrued interest, of the fees or commissions and of the principals. In addition, it provides collateral-specific information.

ValuationAmounts.name: Valuation Amounts
ValuationAmounts.definition: Provides details on the collateral valuation.

MarginRate.name: Margin Rate
MarginRate.definition: The collateral excess/shortage expressed in the percentage of the collateral required.

GlobalCollateralStatus.name: Global Collateral Status
GlobalCollateralStatus.definition: Provides the status after comparing the total collateral required and the total collateral value of all transactions covered in the message.

ValuationDate.name: Valuation Date
ValuationDate.definition: Valuation date/time of both the collateral and the exposure.

CollateralAdditionalDetails.name: Collateral Additional Details
CollateralAdditionalDetails.definition: Provides additional information on the collateral.
